{{Quote|As you know, we've received word of increased Imperial presence in the ''Belial'' system. But since we have no bases or allies in that sector, our information is dangerously incomplete.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 64">[[Star Wars (1977) 64|''Star Wars'' (1977) 64]]</ref>}}
The '''Belial system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Its primary [[Star/Legends|star]] was [[Belial (star)|Belial]], and the system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Serp]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
